claims: As of late March 2026, FHA loan interest rates for 30-year fixed mortgages generally range between 5.85% and 6.35%.
As of late March 2026, Mortgage News Daily shows daily averages around 5.95%–6.05% for FHA loan interest rates for 30-year fixed mortgages.
As of late March 2026, some 15-year fixed FHA loan interest rates are available around 5.75%.
Mortgage News Daily says FHA loan rates fluctuate daily based on market conditions and individual factors like credit score, down payment size, and the loan-to-value ratio.
Rocket Mortgage explains that some lenders may offer lower FHA loan rates by charging up to 1-2 points, affecting the overall Annual Percentage Rate (APR).
